headline: Had hundreds of employees: Textile giant and Istanbul hotel owner goes bankrupt - ensonhaber.com
summary: Germenicia Boya Tekstil, a textile company based in Kahramanmaraş, has gone bankrupt. The company reportedly employed 200 people and had losses over the past two years.
why: Textile manufacturers are significant employers and exporters in Türkiye, and bankruptcies signal stress in the industrial and apparel sector.
